supersedes_note: v1 hit LATTICE_CANARY_FAIL/STOP (T-b, sat_gcd trial-factoring left a 1169-digit UNFACTORED_COFACTOR). v1.1's Tb_closure decisively PROVED the residual is a genuine saturation defect: rank(B mod g)=13<112 for g=632246415007, via 99 independent Howell leaves. This cert (v2_saturate) FIXES that defect per 裁定745(5): direct p-saturation at g, then a standardized bounded-list-free gcd-driven closure loop.
k11_immunity_cross_reference: 裁定745(4): had k=11's B_11 carried an analogous saturation defect at some prime q, rank(N_11 mod q)<60 would force every 60x60 minor of N_11 to vanish mod q, i.e. q | gcd_abs -- but k=11's full-column adaptive Howell closure (cert torsweep_k11_v1_4_20260807.json) independently proved rank=60 mod EVERY prime dividing gcd_abs. That is a direct contradiction, so no such q can exist: the k=11 TOR-UP result (裁定744) is unaffected by the defect fixed in this cert.

This k=12 defect is therefore evidence that the (bounded-list) saturation step CAN silently miss a large prime, not evidence that any already-closed (via unbounded full-column Howell, not the bounded sieve) result is wrong -- the two code paths have different failure surfaces and k=11's conclusion used only the unbounded one.
